children: Japan's ministries and agencies have requested roughly 143 trillion yen ($896 billion) in spending for the fiscal 2027 budget, setting the stage for the largest initial budget request on record, the Nikkei business daily reported on Monday.

The sharp increase reflects the creation of a new growth investment framework with no preset spending ceiling, as well as the government's decision to integrate supplementary and initial budget spending into a unified budgeting process.

The total figure would be 2-3 trillion yen higher than the combined 140.6 trillion yen represented by the fiscal 2025 supplementary budget and the initial fiscal 2026 budget, according to a Nikkei calculation based on spending requests submitted by ministries to the finance ministry.
